integrity: The mathematical argument and the direct finite checks are contained in the package; numerical testing is not claimed to certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Claims cover binary Rudin–Shapiro prefixes at dyadic ranks k>=4 and arbitrary concatenations only of four precisely specified sixteen-symbol blocks; only shortest absent scattered subsequences are counted. Independent verification and exhaustive historical-priority research are not complete.
title: Exact scattered-subsequence universality and absence counts for Rudin–Shapiro prefixes
